en.headline: Lee Tung Avenue hangs more than 800 Mid-Autumn lanterns
en.dek: The Wan Chai pedestrian street’s display runs until 19 October, with lights from 5pm and an 18-metre LED fire dragon parade on 25 September.
body: Lee Tung Avenue in Wan Chai is showing more than 800 lanterns along its 200-metre tree-lined stretch as Mid-Autumn Festival approaches, the venue said, under the title Moon Fest Lumiere, or Colourful Lanterns Greeting the Moon.

The organisers said the display mixes traditional red lanterns with new palace-style lanterns whose paper-cut motifs depict Mid-Autumn legends and family gatherings. The avenue is open from 10am to 11pm, with the lanterns lit from 5pm; lighting is due to run until midnight on 25 September, the festival day.

On 25 September an 18-metre LED fire dragon is scheduled to leave the Central Piazza at 8.30pm, travel toward the Queen’s Road East and Johnston Road entrances, and return to the piazza in a programme of about 45 minutes, with drumming, an LED lion and smoke effects. Mini palace-lantern workshops are listed for 19 and 20 September, and a Mid-Autumn concert for 26 September.
Admission to the street display is free. The organisers said hours may change with the weather and advised visitors to check the avenue’s own notices closer to each event.

zh.headline: 灣仔利東街懸掛逾800盎中秋燈籠至10月
zh.dek: 「彩燈‧迎月」沿200米林藮大道展出至10月19日，下午8時亮燈；9月25日將有18米LED火龍巡遊。
body: 灣仔利東街正舉辦中秋「彩燈‧迎月」，主辦單位表示在全長約4200米的林藮大道懸掛逾800盎燈籠，活動舉行至10月19日。
場地指燈飾結合傳統紅燈籠及今年新推的宮廷燈籠，燈面以剪紙風格圖案描繪后羿、嫦娥等中秋傳說及家庭團圓場面。大道開放時間為上午10時至晚上11時，每日下午5時亮燈；中秋正日9月25日亮燈時間延長至午夜。
9月25日晚上8時30分，一條長18米的LED火龍預定由中庭出發，巡遊至皇后大道東及莊士敦道入口後返回中庭，全程約45分鐘，並有鼓樂、LED醒獅及噴煙效果。主辦單位亦列出9月19及20日迷你宮燈工作坊，以及9月26日中秋音樂會。
燈籠街免費開放。主辦單位表示開放時間或因天氣調整，呼籲市民留意利東街最新公布。
